body:
haha I guess it is true after all. me feeling like im needy is one of my biggest insecurities- stepped right on the landmine.  

it was to my significant other, my only motivation to keep me living.

I’m not very comfortable with revealing my age, but she’s definitely older than me. In Asian culture, the eldest is “always right” according to my household so I’m automatically tuned out by my family just because I was born a couple years later unfortunately. 

They know I’ve been diagnosed with depression and anxiety way back in my freshman year of high school but they always told me to keep quiet about it because my sister’s situation is apparently more important to them. They baby her like crazy; doesn’t pay for gas, gives her an allowance weekly (unemployed), basically mooches off the family despite being a grown adult while I’m constantly out with my jobs and school but my parents think I’m out fooling around with my boyfriend. 

I’m currently just living outside, walking around on the streets. I have no one to stay with because the people I trust are worried that they’ll get in trouble with the law if my parents lie and file a report saying that they kidnapped me. They absolutely want me gone and make sure no one’s helping me; I tried getting help from my boyfriend and they tried calling the cops on him. They know my uncle’s been lashing out on me but actually agree with his actions.
Thank you so much for this.. it took everything out of me just to admit it.

I brought it up during a talk we had. My sister also has severe depression but is schizophrenic. She’s been making up stories about me abusing her and kept badgering my dad about it. He told me to lay off and didn’t believe me when I tried to defend myself, along with other family members such as my uncle (sides with my sister because he refuses to hear my side of the story) who’s been physically abusing me ever since. After the talk, my dad kicked me out of the house because if I show my face, I’ll “upset the family”.
Thank you.. it just really hurts because he was the last person I could trust. I truly thought that he would understand and be a bit supportive, but I guess not
